publications.title: UniSim-SLAM: Feed-Forward SLAM with Unified Sim(3) Optimization
publications.alt: Overview of UniSim-SLAM with two-view tracking and multi-view Sim(3) optimization
publications.description: Combines fast two-view tracking with multi-view refinement through a unified Sim(3) factor graph for geometrically consistent feed-forward SLAM.

publications.title: FeDepth: Federated Learning for Depth Estimation under Robot Heterogeneity
publications.alt: FeDepth federated depth estimation across heterogeneous robot clients
publications.description: Uses descriptor-based soft clustering to learn depth estimation across heterogeneous robots, environments, and sensing conditions without transferring raw data.

publications.title: A Benchmark Dataset for Collaborative SLAM in Service Environments
publications.alt: CSE Dataset service environments and collaborative robot trajectories
publications.description: A synchronized multi-robot benchmark built in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, with three robots in hospital, office, and warehouse environments and paired static/dynamic sequences.

publications.title: AiSDF: Structure-aware Neural Signed Distance Fields in Indoor Scenes
publications.alt: AiSDF neural indoor reconstruction and Atlanta-world planar structure
publications.description: Reconstructs indoor scenes online by combining neural signed distance fields with Atlanta-world structural priors and explicit planar surfels.

publications.title: Fracture Assembly with Segmentation and Iterative Registration
publications.venue: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP)
publications.alt: Fractured 3D shapes and their reassembly with segmentation and registration
publications.description: Reassembles fractured 3D objects by segmenting broken surfaces and aligning fragments through iterative point-cloud registration.

projects.title: Autonomous Driving: Path Planning & Control
projects.alt: Original vehicle demonstration of static obstacle avoidance
projects.description: Led team development of the path-planning and vehicle-control system for the 2020 university creative-car competition. Integrated global reference paths prepared in QGIS with local obstacle avoidance, Pure Pursuit tracking, parking, emergency braking, and traffic-light handling.
projects.technologies: C++ · Python · ROS · Vehicle control · Local planning · Global path planning · Pure Pursuit · QGIS

projects.title: Cooperative Driving at Intersections
projects.alt: Experimental intersection for vehicle-to-infrastructure cooperative driving
projects.description: Combined vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) communication with camera-based vehicle localization for intersection collision avoidance. Used ArUco markers to estimate vehicle positions relative to the traffic-light camera and tested scenarios with a red-light-violating vehicle.
projects.technologies: ROS · V2I communication · Computer vision · ArUco localization · Collision avoidance

projects.title: Indoor Delivery Robot
projects.alt: Indoor delivery robot and its corresponding 3D model
projects.description: Integrated GMapping for map creation, AMCL for localization, and the Dynamic Window Approach (DWA) for local navigation in an indoor delivery robot. Added QR-code-based recipient verification at the delivery destination.
projects.technologies: ROS · GMapping · AMCL · DWA local planning · QR-code verification

projects.title: RANSAC-based Lane Detection
projects.alt: Lane detection with a bird's-eye image and RANSAC lane fitting
projects.description: A ROS vision pipeline that transforms camera images into a bird’s-eye view, parameterizes lane lines in cylindrical coordinates, and fits white and yellow lanes with sliding-window RANSAC to generate waypoints for lane following.

projects.title: Balancing Robot
projects.alt: Self-balancing robot with stepper motors and a six-axis motion sensor
projects.description: Built a self-balancing robot using a six-axis motion sensor and PID feedback control. An ARM Cortex-M microcontroller converts the balance error into stepper-motor commands.
projects.technologies: C++ · ARM Cortex-M · TrueSTUDIO · PID control · Six-axis sensing · Stepper motors

projects.title: High-Speed Line Tracer
projects.alt: Custom high-speed line-tracing robot with infrared sensors and stepper motors
projects.description: Built a high-speed line-following robot with hand-built hardware, an STM32 / ARM Cortex-M microcontroller, infrared sensors, and stepper motors. PID steering and speed control support running speeds of 1.5–2.4 m/s.
projects.technologies: C (Embedded C) · ARM Cortex-M · STM32 · Infrared sensing · PID control

projects.title: Hand-Tracking Rhythm Game
projects.alt: Rhythm game controlled by detected and tracked hand movements
projects.description: A camera-based rhythm game controlled by hand motion. Color segmentation and histogram backprojection detect the hands, while Mean Shift tracks them for interactive gameplay.
projects.technologies: C++ · OpenCV · MFC · Mean Shift tracking

ongoing_work.title: Long-Horizon Spatial Memory for Multi-Robot Geometric Foundation Models
ongoing_work.description: Developing shared spatial memory for multi-robot geometric foundation models, with revisit-driven updates for implicit loop closure and efficient map representations.

ongoing_work.title: Lifelong 3D Map Management with Multi-Session Scene Change Detection
ongoing_work.description: Developing real-time, multi-session scene change detection to update 3D maps as environments evolve.

ongoing_work.title: AI Bots Collaboration Platform and Self-Organizing AI
ongoing_work.description: Researching multi-robot SLAM, inter-robot coordination, and collaborative mapping for distributed autonomous systems.
